card.name: First digit after a comma in numbers
card.fires_on: A single leading digit (usually 1 or 2) that begins a number right after a comma and space, in lists of years, counts or percentages. The digit is split off from the rest of the number.

modes.label: Year lists
modes.description: The first digit of a year in a comma-separated list of dates.

modes.label: Counts and percentages
modes.description: The leading digit of a number after a comma in trial or statistics text.

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number that follows a comma, such as a year in a list or a percentage in results.
